title: docs(automation): say an http node's url and headers are served; route credentials to connector credentialRef
body:
Fixes #20655
Clause-②: no

Docs half of #20590 (guidance faces only, nothing withheld, no code touched). Two pages, three edits.

## What changed
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`, HTTP Request example: the secret-bearing incoming-webhook url is replaced by a neutral `https://api.example.com/v1/order-events`, and a warning callout follows it.
- `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`, `rest` provider: one paragraph pointing `headers` / `defaultHeaders` to `auth.credentialRef`.

## The sentence (for #20654 to copy)
No open PR links #20654 and it has no PR yet, so this page writes the sentence first. #20654 must copy it verbatim into the spec describe text:

> A flow definition, including an `http` node's `url` and `headers`, is served to every member who can read flows.

The callout continues: a token, API key or signed webhook url written there is readable by all of them; route an outbound credential to a declarative connector's `auth.credentialRef` and call it with a `connector_action` node.

## Claims verified against origin/main f4ce10c89d
- Served: `GET /:name` answers `servedFlowDefinition(flow)` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:3028-3034`); the redactor is `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-credential-projection.ts`, table `FLOW_NODE_CREDENTIAL_KEYS` (`start` -> `secret`, `http` -> `signingSecret`). Only those two keys are dropped, so `url` and `headers` are served as written. The callout says so, so it does not overclaim.
- Consumed: the `http` node reads `cfg.url` and `cfg.headers` verbatim (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts:125-129`), sends `headers` on the request (`:255-261`).
- `credentialRef`: `auth` on a provider-bound instance (`packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts:1005`), `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` variants bearer / api-key / basic each with `credentialRef: z.string().min(1)` (`packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts:123-152`); the rest provider receives the resolved auth (`packages/connectors/connector-rest/src/rest-provider.ts:53`).

## Acceptance notes
- Flows have no per-type read permission on this path (the per-caller read gate in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` covers docs, apps and books); the docs therefore say "every member who can read flows", the triage direction's wording, and do not name a permission.
- `flows.mdx` still lists "an `http` node posting to an incoming webhook" as the Slack replacement in the retired-shapes table. Left untouched (out of this card's three edits).

## Gates
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 40 derived, 40 run, reconciled with `--ran` at head 2c78a7a2ec. All exit 0, except `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (`packages/client-react/dist` not built): NOT MEASURED, and it reads skills, not these pages.
